comment: Dr. Nourse is incredibly kind and caring. This is a very laid back class. and I would definitely take it again. I'm a senior and I took this to fill out my schedule. I don't regret it one bit. She was nice and it was an easy class, which is exactly what a 101 class should be. theres one midterm, a reading response paragraph every friday.

Take her for a chill, easy A!  lot of reading, but it easy to skim. Clear-cut concepts/easy to grasp. She's disorganized but creates low-pressure environment. You must participate and checks off each time you do, but provide online participation credit. Sit down midterm exam, after that, there's no more cumulative work. Final paper on your choice.

Super easy professor and would def recommend taking if you want a free course. She assigns a lot of readings per class but you don't even have to do them. For a participation grade, you just have to say one thing per class and if you don't want to, she has you answer two quick discussion questions on blackboard to get credit for that class.

Weekly assignments. If you don't attend class, there is still opportunity for you to earn credit. Lectures are super disorganized. She is laid back and lenient. Keep in mind, two 10 page papers a week apart from each other.

The workload for this class was initially really light- reading and weekly comprehension paragraphs. At the end of the semester we had presentations, and several papers upwards of 10-15+ pages each all due within a week or two of each other. But if you follow the rubric and cite everything correctly you will do well. VERY Disorganized power-points.

Dr. Nourse is very caring and wants the best for her students. She grades fairly and a large amount of your grade is simply speaking in class. There is a year long project but it is broken up so it is very manageable. Take a quick read of material before class and contribute in class and you'll pass with flying colors.

Nourse is a sweet light-hearted lady, albeit pretty quirky at times. Material is pretty cut-and-dry. If you regurgitate verbatim her lectures and powerpoints on exams and writing assignments along with occasionally answering questions in class, an A is pretty easy. You'll enjoy this class for a gen-ed humanities while learning a few things.

Dr. Nourse is a fun professor. She is not very organized and class can go in unexpected directions. She is helpful with organizing papers and is always willing to meet. She is also not a difficult grader. If you participate a couple times in class and stay on top of the assignments, an A is not difficult.

Very easy to work with, yet very disorganized. She assigns textbook readings, however, she may experiment a new textbook every now and then with her class. Sometimes, she goes off on tangents about certain things that make her incomprehensible. Workload is manageable, I would definitely take another class with her.

Ms. Nourse is the slightest bit insane. She   seems to be perpetually flustered. Overall, her class isn't too challenging, but her grading is very subjective on whether she likes you. I did learn the basics of anthropology though with very little time commitment.

Even though she is the slightest bit mad, class, or maybe just the material, is interesting. Her stories are great, relevant or not. Helpful and a really easy paper grader.  Come to class for participation grade and b/c everything on test is said verbatim in class.  Chill class overall, fairly easy A.

as a core teacher, she isn't difficult. she's pretty scatter-brained and always came to class unorganized and seemingly flustered. her notes were all over the place, but she always had interesting comments and funny stories from her experiences abroad that somehow relate to the studied material. inconsistent grader on papers! participate in class!

Dr. Nourse may be one of the most laid-back core teachers out there. If you ask her to look at your paper prior to the due date you'll get atleast a B. Midterm and final are easy. However, make sure you participate every day,since participation is worth 15% of your grade. Overall, very easy class.
Very easy teacher.  If you pay attention in class and are a decent writer, you will get an A.  Extremely flexible.

Dr. Nourse, is an awesome teacher. She is very understanding on how much students dislike core class, and takes that into consideration in discussions. If you just respect her and do the work, you will do fine! Make sure for papers, you do rough drafts, they really help your grade
Nourse is awesome.  One of my favorite professors.  Yes, she is a little scattered, but that's what makes her so much fun.
No Comments
Dr. Nourse is awesome. If you can switch into her core class take her. Best class discussions. If you take notes, do most of the reading, and pay attention into class, you will do fine.

Dr. Nourse is a little crazy, which is what made class fun!  Compared to the work other people do Core, her class was easy, especially because you get to choose your own topics for the papers you write.  Read the material, talk in class, spend time on your papers. I'd take another class from her!
incompetent, stubborn, unfair, grades arbitrarily, generally gives the impression that she has no idea what she is talking about

Kinda crazy and disheveled but her class structure is very simple. write questions on the board, answer them in class. Ask those same questions on the final exam.  Lots of memorization but no surprises.
She lets the students discuss what they would like to discuss... works out well... not too much work... show up knowing the reading, talk a little bit, do the required papers and your set
This lady is a nut job!  She does not seem to know what she is talking about so it is up to you to do the work on your own.  But if you do the req. work you will do great.  Very easy.
No Comments
Dr. Nourse is a good teacher.  She cares about her students, and is a fair grader.  If you do the work, you will be fine.
